scene.speaker: mateo
scene.bubble: Saturday jobs at the club house! I feed Luna, Erik fixes things… and the rubbish goes out BEFORE it smells.
scene.intro: Saturday jobs at the club house! Mateo has to feed Luna and sweep the floor. Erik has to wash the dishes and water the plants, but first he has to fix the machine that broke last week. Everybody has to take out the rubbish — nobody wants to. When the work is finished, the club house is clean and the afternoon is free. What do YOU have to do at home?

activities.title: Grammar · Mum wants me to help
activities.instructions: Read the sentences. Then choose the right word.
activities.structure: Want / ask someone to do something

data.title: Mum wants me to help
data.intro: You want something — but you want somebody else to do it. The person goes in the middle, between the verb and to.
data.can: I can say who wants somebody to do something: Mum wants me to wash the dishes.

examples.text: He wants the teacher to tell a story.
Mum wants me to wash the dishes.
Erik asked Mateo to feed the cat.
Do you want me to help you with the rubbish?

rules: The person in the middle is me, you, him, her, us, them — or a name.
Never "She wants that I help". English puts the person straight after the verb.
